title: Systems Map Example — Coffee Shop
description: Explore a coffee shop as a systems map, with money, goods and information flows drawn in three distinct line styles.
creator: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
Mental Models and Systems Analysis Tools
chapter_title: Mental Models and Systems Analysis Tools

educational.learningObjective: Given a familiar small business, the learner will illustrate how people, resources and information connect across a systems map.
prerequisites: Knows what a node and an edge represent
Has been inside a small business
learningOutcomes: Distinguish money, goods and information flows in one diagram
Explain why information flows matter even though they carry nothing physical
Identify a single point of failure from a systems map
educational.assessmentOpportunity: Ask learners to add one node and two arrows to this map (for example, a landlord or a delivery app) and to label each new arrow's flow type. Correct flow typing is the thing to check.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-any-element exploration on a physics-laid-out network
pedagogical.feedbackType: An explanation panel for every node and every edge
misconceptionsAddressed: That a systems map only shows physical or financial flows
That the position of nodes in the drawing carries meaning
discussionQuestions: The supplier is outside the shop but inside the system. What else is like that in your organization?
Why are information flows the easiest to cut and the most damaging to lose?
What does this map leave out, and does leaving it out matter?
